name: Featured Image Plus – Bulk Edit Featured Images, Unsplash & Alt Text Manager
author: Krasen Slavov

sections.description:
Bulk edit featured images instantly with Featured Image Plus – the WordPress featured image manager with bulk editing, Unsplash integration, and alt text management for faster content workflows.

Stop setting featured images one post at a time. Featured Image Plus extends WordPress Quick Edit and Bulk Edit with featured image management, Unsplash API integration for free stock photos, and alt text bulk editing. Add, remove, or update featured images for 200+ posts with one click, set default featured images, and manage SEO-friendly alt text from a single dashboard.

Whether you’re managing WooCommerce products, blog posts, or custom post types, Featured Image Plus makes WordPress featured image management fast and efficient.

Why Choose Featured Image Plus?

  • Bulk Edit Featured Images – Add featured images to 200+ posts instantly
  • Quick Edit Manager – Update featured images without opening posts
  • Unsplash Integration – Free stock photos with API integration
  • Alt Text Manager – Bulk edit featured image alt text for SEO
  • Default Featured Image – Set fallback images for posts
  • Dashboard Widget – Track featured image statistics

How WordPress Bulk Featured Image Edit Works

  1. Install and activate Featured Image Plus on your WordPress site
  2. Navigate to Posts or Pages in WordPress admin
  3. Select multiple posts/pages with checkboxes
  4. Choose Bulk Actions > Edit and click Apply
  5. Click Browse in Featured Image field, select image
  6. Click Update – featured image added to all selected posts
  7. Or use Unsplash integration to fetch free stock photos

Zero configuration required – bulk edit WordPress featured images immediately.

Perfect For

  • Bloggers adding featured images to existing WordPress posts
  • WooCommerce Stores managing product featured images in bulk
  • Content Managers updating featured images across WordPress site
  • SEO Specialists optimizing featured image alt text for search
  • Publishers setting default featured images for consistency
  • Agencies managing WordPress featured images for client sites

WordPress Bulk Featured Image Features

Bulk Edit Featured Images
Add, remove, or update featured images for up to 200 WordPress posts simultaneously. Select posts with checkboxes, use Bulk Edit action, browse Media Library, and apply featured images to all selected posts with one click. Massive time-saver for WordPress content management.

Quick Edit Featured Images
Update WordPress featured images without opening post editor. Click Quick Edit on any post, browse Media Library in inline editor, select featured image, and update instantly. Perfect for fast WordPress featured image changes across multiple posts.

Unsplash API Integration
Access millions of free Unsplash stock photos directly from WordPress. Connect Unsplash API, search by keywords, and attach featured images to posts automatically. Real-time API testing, error handling, and keyword suggestions ensure smooth WordPress stock photo integration.

Alt Text Manager for WordPress
Bulk edit featured image alt text for SEO optimization. View all posts missing alt text, add SEO-friendly descriptions inline, character counter recommends 125 characters, and bulk save changes. Improve WordPress image SEO without editing individual posts.

Default Featured Image
Set fallback featured image for WordPress posts without images. Upload default image in settings, automatically displays on posts missing featured images. Ensures consistent WordPress visual presentation across site.

Dashboard Widget Statistics
Real-time WordPress featured image statistics showing posts with/without images, missing alt text counts, and featured image coverage percentage. Quick insights into WordPress content image status from dashboard.

Usage

Once the WordPress featured image bulk editor is installed and activated:

  1. Go to Posts or Pages in WordPress admin
  2. Select multiple posts using checkboxes
  3. Choose Bulk Actions > Edit from dropdown
  4. Click Apply button
  5. Featured Image field appears in bulk editor
  6. Click Browse to select image from Media Library
  7. Or use Remove ALL Featured Images to delete
  8. Click Update to apply to all selected posts

Here are the steps to use Featured Image Plus:

  1. Select Posts – Check multiple WordPress posts to bulk edit
  2. Bulk Edit – Choose Bulk Actions > Edit and Apply
  3. Browse Image – Select featured image from Media Library
  4. Update – Apply featured image to all selected posts
  5. Quick Edit – Or use Quick Edit for single post updates
  6. Unsplash – Fetch free stock photos with Unsplash integration
  7. Alt Text – Manage SEO alt text from Alt Text Manager tab

Note: WooCommerce products and custom post types supported in Pro version.

WordPress Bulk Featured Image Settings

Bulk Edit Featured Images:
1. Navigate to Posts or Pages in WordPress admin
2. Select multiple posts with checkboxes (up to 200)
3. Choose Bulk Actions > Edit from dropdown menu
4. Click Apply button
5. Bulk Edit panel appears with Featured Image field
6. Click Browse button to open Media Library
7. Select featured image
8. Click Update to apply to all selected WordPress posts

Quick Edit Featured Images:
1. Hover over any WordPress post in list
2. Click Quick Edit link
3. Featured Image field appears in inline editor
4. Click Browse to select from Media Library
5. Choose featured image
6. Click Update to save WordPress post

Unsplash Integration:
1. Go to Featured Image+ > Settings in WordPress admin
2. Enter Unsplash API Key
3. Click Test Connection to verify API
4. Edit any WordPress post
5. Unsplash option appears in featured image area
6. Keywords auto-generate from post title/categories
7. Click to fetch free Unsplash stock photo

Alt Text Manager:
1. Access Featured Image+ > Alt Text Manager
2. View all WordPress posts with featured images
3. Filter by: All Posts, Missing Alt Text, Has Alt Text
4. Edit alt text inline with character counter
5. Click Bulk Save to update all WordPress posts
6. SEO recommendations included (125 characters)

Default Featured Image:
1. Go to Featured Image+ > Settings
2. Upload default fallback image
3. Save settings
4. WordPress posts without featured images show default

Supported WordPress Features:
– Posts bulk edit
– Pages bulk edit
– Quick edit for posts/pages
– Unsplash stock photos
– Alt text management
– Default featured images

Features & Limitations

The Featured Image Plus WordPress featured image plugin allows you to:

  • Bulk edit featured images for up to 200 WordPress posts
  • Add featured images to multiple posts with one click
  • Remove featured images from multiple WordPress posts
  • Quick edit featured images without opening post editor
  • Integrate Unsplash API for free stock photos
  • Test Unsplash API connection from WordPress settings
  • Manage featured image alt text for SEO optimization
  • View dashboard widget with featured image statistics
  • Set default featured image for WordPress posts
  • Filter posts by missing alt text
  • Bulk save alt text changes across WordPress
  • Character counter for SEO-friendly alt text
  • Support Posts and Pages in free version
  • Auto-generate keywords from post content for Unsplash
  • Real-time API error handling and validation

WordPress Featured Image Components

Bulk Edit Manager
WordPress bulk editor extension adding featured image management to native bulk actions. Select up to 200 posts, apply featured images, or remove all images with single action. Streamlines WordPress content management.

Quick Edit Integration
Inline featured image editor integrated into WordPress Quick Edit. Browse Media Library, select images, and update without opening post editor. Fast WordPress featured image changes.

Unsplash Stock Photos
Free stock photo integration via Unsplash API. Automatic keyword generation from WordPress post titles, categories, and tags. Real-time API testing, connection validation, and error handling.

Alt Text Manager Dashboard
Dedicated WordPress dashboard for bulk alt text editing. Filter posts missing alt text, edit inline with character counter, SEO recommendations at 125 characters, and bulk save functionality.

Dashboard Widget
Real-time WordPress statistics showing posts with/without featured images, missing alt text counts, and image coverage percentages. Quick insights from WordPress admin dashboard.

Default Image System
Fallback featured image for WordPress posts without images. Upload once in settings, automatically displays across site ensuring consistent visual presentation.

Known Limitations

Free version features:

  • Post Types – Posts and Pages only (WooCommerce/CPTs in Pro)
  • Bulk Edit Limit – 200 posts maximum (Higher limits in Pro)
  • Unsplash – Basic integration (AI DALL-E in Pro)
  • Auto-Attach – Not available (Auto-attach from content in Pro)
  • WooCommerce – Not supported (Full WooCommerce in Pro)
  • Custom Post Types – Not supported (All CPTs in Pro)
  • Taxonomies – Basic (All public taxonomies in Pro)
  • Priority Support – Community only (Direct support in Pro)

Detailed Documentation

Find step-by-step setup guides, video tutorials, WordPress featured image best practices, and bulk editing tips on the Featured Image Plus Documentation page.

Featured Image Plus Pro

If you’re using the free WordPress featured image plugin from WordPress.org and want Pro features, you can purchase the premium version on the Featured Image Plus Pro website.

Here are some features included in the Pro version:

  • AI Image Creator – Generate featured images with OpenAI DALL-E 2 integration
  • WooCommerce Support – Bulk edit product featured images and galleries
  • Custom Post Types – Full support for all WordPress custom post types
  • Auto-Attach Images – Extract featured images from post content automatically
  • Unsplash & DALL-E – Both free stock photos and AI-generated images
  • All Public Taxonomies – Featured images for categories, tags, custom taxonomies
  • Featured Image Visibility – Control featured image display positions
  • Image Size Control – Manage featured image dimensions and cropping
  • Classic/Block/Elementor – Works with all WordPress editors
  • Bulk Operations – Higher limits for bulk featured image editing
  • Advanced Alt Text – Additional SEO optimization features
  • Priority Support – Direct email support from WordPress experts
  • Regular Updates – Early access to new featured image features
sections.installation:
Installing the WordPress featured image bulk editor is straightforward. Contact support if you encounter any issues.

Requirements:
– WordPress 5.0 or higher
– PHP 7.2 or higher
– Media Library access

Installation from WordPress

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for Featured Image Plus
  3. Click Install Now then Activate
  4. Navigate to Featured Image+ in admin menu (optional)

Manual Installation

  1. Download the WordPress featured image plugin ZIP file
  2. Upload the featured-image-plus folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Go to Plugins in WordPress admin
  4. Activate Featured Image Plus
  5. Navigate to Featured Image+ in admin menu (optional)

After Activation

  1. Go to Posts or Pages in WordPress admin
  2. Select multiple posts with checkboxes
  3. Choose Bulk Actions > Edit and click Apply
  4. Click Browse in Featured Image field
  5. Select image from Media Library
  6. Click Update to apply featured image to all posts
  7. Or use Quick Edit for individual post updates
  8. Configure Unsplash API in Featured Image+ > Settings (optional)
  9. Manage alt text in Featured Image+ > Alt Text Manager (optional)

Quick Start:
1. Select multiple WordPress posts
2. Bulk Actions > Edit > Apply
3. Browse and select featured image
4. Update – done!
sections.faq:
Visit the Support Forum to share your questions or requests.

We usually respond to tickets within a few days.

Feature requests are added to our wish list and considered for future updates.

How to bulk edit featured images in WordPress?

Go to Posts or Pages, select multiple posts with checkboxes, choose Bulk Actions > Edit, click Apply. In the bulk editor, click Browse in Featured Image field, select image, and click Update. Featured image applies to all selected WordPress posts.

What’s the best WordPress featured image bulk editor?

Featured Image Plus provides comprehensive bulk editing for WordPress featured images with Quick Edit integration, Unsplash stock photos, alt text management, and dashboard statistics. Handles 200+ posts per bulk operation.

How to add featured images to multiple WordPress posts?

Install Featured Image Plus, select posts in WordPress admin, use Bulk Actions > Edit, browse Media Library for featured image, and update. All selected WordPress posts receive the same featured image instantly.

Does this work with WooCommerce products?

WooCommerce product support is available in Featured Image Plus Pro. The free version supports WordPress Posts and Pages only.

Can I remove featured images in bulk?

Yes, select WordPress posts with checkboxes, choose Bulk Actions > Edit, click the Remove ALL Featured Images button, and update. Featured images removed from all selected posts simultaneously.

How does Unsplash integration work?

Connect Unsplash API key in Featured Image Plus settings. When editing WordPress posts, keywords auto-generate from titles/categories. Fetch free Unsplash stock photos and attach as featured images automatically.

Can I edit featured image alt text in bulk?

Yes, go to Featured Image+ > Alt Text Manager, filter posts missing alt text, edit inline with character counter recommending 125 characters for SEO, and bulk save changes across all WordPress posts.

How to set default featured image in WordPress?

Navigate to Featured Image+ > Settings, upload default featured image, and save. WordPress posts without featured images automatically display the default fallback image across your site.

What is Quick Edit for featured images?

Quick Edit lets you update WordPress featured images without opening post editor. Click Quick Edit on any post, browse Media Library in inline editor, select featured image, and save instantly.

How many posts can I bulk edit at once?

Featured Image Plus handles up to 200 WordPress posts per bulk edit operation. Increase WordPress “Number of items per page” in Screen Options to select more posts for bulk featured image editing.

Does this work with custom post types?

Custom post type support is available in Pro version. The free version supports WordPress Posts and Pages for featured image bulk editing.

Can I see which posts are missing featured images?

Yes, the Dashboard Widget shows real-time statistics including posts without featured images, missing alt text counts, and featured image coverage percentage across your WordPress site.

How to get Unsplash API key?

Create free Unsplash developer account at unsplash.com/developers, register application, copy API key, and enter in Featured Image Plus settings. Test connection to verify WordPress Unsplash integration.

Does this work with Gutenberg Block Editor?

Yes, Featured Image Plus works with WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg), Classic Editor, and Elementor in Pro version. Bulk edit and quick edit functions work across all WordPress editors.

Can I auto-attach images from post content?

Auto-attach featured images from post content is available in Pro version. Automatically extract first image from WordPress post content and set as featured image.

Is this compatible with WordPress themes?

Yes, Featured Image Plus works with all WordPress themes. Bulk editing modifies standard WordPress featured images, compatible with any theme using WordPress featured image functions.
